node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, clamps, connectors, and conductor-adjacent components
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe for qualified transmission-line hardware. The strongest underfollowed pure-play candidate is Preformed Line Products, whose catalog and third-party research point to direct exposure in conductor fittings, OPGW hardware, dead-ends, clamps, anchoring and line-protection products. Hubbell is the obvious large-cap product leader with transmission connectors, insulators, arresters, anchors and line hardware, but its market cap and broader electrical portfolio make it a reference name rather than the main underfollowed discovery target. Valmont is adjacent through utility transmission structures and substation structures rather than small conductor fittings, while Quanta is a demand/customer anchor because transmission EPC activity consumes this hardware but does not manufacture the chokepoint products. No buy/sell view is implied; this is a research-universe expansion only.
